test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Everybody was surprised to see that he __fell flat__ even after arduous efforts.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"fell flat"** means to fail to achieve the desired effect or to be unsuccessful in making an impression. (विफल होना) • **Example: **The comedian's joke** fell flat,** and nobody in the audience laughed. • **"Fail to win applause"** refers to not receiving any recognition, praise, or positive response for one's efforts. (तालियां नहीं मिलना) • **Example: **Despite his hard work, his presentation fell flat and f**ailed to win applause** from the audience. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Fail to win applause. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Win a difficult race** (कठिन दौड़ जीतना): To succeed in a challenging competition. • **Example:** She trained hard every day to win a difficult race at the national championship. • **Succeed without hassles** (बिना परेशानी के सफल होना): To achieve success easily without any difficulties. • **Example:** He managed to succeed without hassles in getting his project approved by the committee. • **Fall from a height** (ऊंचाई से गिरना): To physically drop or fall from an elevated place. • **Example:** The cat fell from a height but luckily didn't get hurt. 166:T666, The correct answer is **Option 4)**
